about: v2 P07-E6: arboreal remnants and foragers also drop the Bag of Eitn Ot Pyrk on Xaxnxi's Quest steps 1-5

entries.why: period walkthrough (Allakhazam Xaxnxi's Quest, Meri of Bedevere note): 'Arboreal remnant defender, arboreal remnant, and arboreal forager ... all ... drop the bag' (Related NPCs: Arboreal Remnant, Arboreal Remnant Defender, Arboreal Remnant Forager); with ClassicQuests commit 2574660 a Drops entry whose item is the kill step's own item (cq_bag_of_eitn_ot_pyrk;40) advances the step like the defender, at the step's 40% chance
